subject: tf-sh
title: (R)TF.SH.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Diagram in WAC-20, the page where Braxton argues that western art music's progression after Schoenberg must be viewed via two information lines: (1) the 'isolated reality expansion' through its own continuum (source initiation), and (2) 'the collective inter-relationship of world information lines as a factor relevant for dynamic extension' (source transfer). (R)TF-SH — the *reality* of transfer shift — is crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle): the question is what real transfer shift looks like when crossed with the world-expansion principle, the structural pairing the section's prose has been building toward. Three upstream feeds converge: IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) → EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics) → TF-SH; ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) → TF-SH; INFO-DOC (information documentation) → TF-SH; and MTH (methodology) → TF-SH. TF-SH outputs to WO-EXP-PRI (the crossing) → AFL (affinity alignment), and to PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). Structural argument: real transfer shift is fed by *four* upstream constituents — isolated-focus activism producing expansion dynamics, alternative composite progressionalism, information documentation, and methodology — meaning Braxton sees source-transfer as requiring all four kinds of upstream pressure to be 'real' rather than nominal. Once activated, it produces both world-expansion-principle → affinity-alignment and projectional-dynamics → progressional-continuance — i.e., it grounds *both* the world-cosmic and the cultural-progressional layers.
